tasks.final_text: Shopper's World is an open-air shopping center in Framingham, Massachusetts. The original facility (spelled Shoppers' World) is of historical significance as one of the first suburban shopping malls in the United States upon opening in 1951; though it had a central courtyard and covered walkways, it was not fully indoor.

I love the Chicken Bacon Ranch pizza from Slab Pizza. It's the greatest slice out there. Not a traditional New York slice, not a Chicago deep dish, not the greatest crust. But holy cow that thing is special. The ranch itself is supreme, so good in fact that I often get a side of ranch to deep the already-ranchy pizza into. That good.
